evidence: For the social-proof requirement the run refused to invent testimonials and instead wrote visible placeholders ("❝ [ADD A REAL SUBSCRIBER QUOTE HERE] ❞ — replace with an actual reader comment before publishing"), and every other slide/caption line traces to the supplied tips.md text or the user's own message (e.g. slide 11 notes "'Lands in your inbox weekly' is taken directly from the user's own message ... not invented").
